scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others "sass --watch src/scss/main.scss:dist/css/bundle.css --style=expanded" "esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --outfile=dist/js/bundle.js --watch"
scripts.build: sass src/scss/main.scss dist/css/bundle.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && esbuild src/js/main.js --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/js/bundle.js && node build/validate.js
scripts.package: node build/package-theme.js --preflight && npm run build && node build/package-theme.js
